_note: Integrated Chinese, Simplified: Level 1 Parts 1-2 (lessons 1-20) and Level 2 Parts 1-2 (lessons 21-40). RECONSTRUCTED from general knowledge of these textbooks — NOT scanned from them. Each lesson carries a confidence rating; correct anything that is wrong against your own copy. This file is hand-editable: after editing, open Settings and press 'Sync deck' to fold your corrections into the flashcards. Cards are keyed by characters, so fixing a pinyin or a meaning updates the card in place and your review history is kept.

lessons.theme: Two students meet for the first time: exchanging greetings, asking for and giving surnames and full names, using polite titles (Mr./Miss), stating whether one is a teacher or a student, and saying what country or city one is from.

vocab.english: fine; good; nice; O.K.; it's settled
please (polite form of request); to treat or to invite (somebody)
(one's) surname is...; to be surnamed; surname
(particle for a follow-up question: and you?)
(particle that turns a statement into a yes/no question)

grammar.description: The verb 姓 must be followed directly by a surname and is never used alone as an answer; 您贵姓 is the polite way to ask someone's surname, and the answer omits 贵. For example: Wǒ xìng Lǐ. / Nín guì xìng?.
The verb 叫 is followed by a given name or a full name (never a surname alone) and asks or states what someone is called.
呢 forms an abbreviated follow-up question that bounces the same question back: 'and you?'
The verb 是 links two nouns to say A is B; it is negated with 不是.
Adding 吗 to the end of a declarative sentence turns it into a yes/no question with no change in word order.
The negative adverb 不 goes immediately before the verb or adjective, and is pronounced bú before a fourth-tone syllable.
The adverb 也 (too, also) must stand before the verb and can never begin a sentence; with negation it becomes 也不.
Equational sentences with 是; negated with 不是
Yes/no questions by adding 吗 to a statement
Bounce-back questions: 我是学生，你呢？
'Also' — goes before the verb, never at the end
姓 takes a surname only; 叫 takes full name or given name

lessons.theme: Looking at a family photo and talking about family: identifying relatives, saying how many people are in one's family, and describing family members' occupations.

vocab.english: (measure word for many common everyday objects)
(measure word for number of family members)

grammar.description: 的 links a possessor to what is possessed; it is usually omitted before close kinship terms and personal relations (我妈妈, 他姐姐).
A measure word is required between a number and a noun; 个 is the most common one, and 口 is used for the number of people in a family.

grammar.pattern: 这是谁？/ 你家有几口人？
grammar.description: Question pronouns (谁, 什么, 几) sit in the same slot the answer occupies — the word order does not change and no 吗 is added.
grammar.pinyin: zhè shì shéi？/ nǐ jiā yǒu jī kǒu rén？

grammar.description: 有 indicates possession; the answer replaces the question word with the specific item or number.
有 is negated only with 没 (没有), never with 不.
有 also expresses existence — how many people or things there are in a place or group.
grammar.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén。

grammar.pattern: 二 vs. 两 + M + N
grammar.description: 两 is used before a measure word to mean 'two of something'; 二 is used for counting, for numbers, and in ordinals.
都 sums up the people or things already mentioned and must stand before the verb; 都不 = none, 不都 = not all.
Possessive linking: 我的家, 妈妈的照片; often dropped for close relations (我妈妈)
To have; negated with 没, never 不
Asking 'how many' for small quantities: 你家有几口人？
两 before measure words (两个哥哥), 二 in counting
'Both/all' — before the verb, after the subject

lessons.theme: Dates, days of the week and clock time: asking someone's birthday and age, inviting a friend out to eat, arranging when to meet, and giving reasons for an invitation.

vocab.english: (measure word for number in a series; day of the month)
to give birth to; to be born
Is it O.K.? What is it like? How does that sound?
to like; to like to; to prefer; to prefer to
to know (someone); to be acquainted with; to recognize

grammar.description: Dates go from the largest unit to the smallest: year, month, day of the month (号 in speech, 日 in writing), then the day of the week. For example: …nián…yuè…hào (rì), xīngqī….
Clock time uses 点 for the hour with 半 (half) and 刻 (quarter); "two o'clock" is 两点, never 二点. For example: liǎng diǎn bàn / wǔ diǎn sān kè / liù diǎn yí kè.
A pronoun modifies a noun with 的; 的 is usually dropped before close family or personal relationships (我妈妈, 我朋友). For example: wǒ de shēngrì / tā de tóngxué.
Pivotal sentence: the object of 请 ("invite/treat") is at the same time the subject of the second verb phrase.
Alternative question offering two choices; 吗 is never added, and 还是 (not 和/或者) links the alternatives.
Affirmative-negative (A-not-A) question, equivalent in meaning to a 吗 question; no 吗 is used at the end. For example: máng bu máng? / shì bu shì?.
Expresses "too/extremely"; with positive adjectives it is praise (太好了), with others a complaint (太忙了).
The adverb 还 means "also; too; as well" and adds a further item to what has already been mentioned; it goes before the verb.
为什么 asks for a reason; the answer normally begins with 因为.
Big to small: 年 → 月 → 号 → 星期 → 点; time words before the verb
Excessive degree: 太好了, 太忙了
Age/date sentences drop 是: 今天九月十二号, 我今年十九岁

lessons.theme: Talking about weekend activities and pastimes: saying what you like or dislike doing, inviting a friend to a movie or a ball game, treating someone, and giving reasons with 因为…所以….

vocab.english: to watch; to look; to read
(a point in) time; moment; (a duration of) time
to invite someone (to dinner, coffee, etc.); to play the host
to want to; would like to; to think
to sleep; to go to bed
to sleep (the verb on its own)
sleep (the noun: a period of sleeping)

grammar.description: Basic Chinese word order: subject, then time word, then adverb, then verb and object — time words and adverbs go before the verb, never after it.

grammar.pattern: 喜欢不喜欢…? / 喜不喜欢…?
grammar.description: A-not-A questions with two-syllable verbs; the second syllable of the first half may be omitted.
grammar.pinyin: xǐhuan bù xǐhuan…? / xǐ bù xǐhuan…?

grammar.description: 那(么) is a conjunction meaning "then; in that case", linking a remark to what the other speaker just said.
去 plus an action verb phrase means "go and do something"; the two verbs share one subject. For example: qù kàn diànyǐng / qù dǎ qiú.
Tag questions added after a suggestion to ask for the listener's agreement.
The auxiliary (modal) verb 想 means "would like to; want to"; negate with 不想, question with 想不想.
Unlike English, Chinese normally keeps both halves of the cause-and-effect pair, with the reason clause first.

grammar.pattern: 有的 + N / 有的时候
grammar.description: 有的 means "some (of a known group)" and directly modifies a noun; 有的时候 means "sometimes".
'Want to / would like to' before a verb
V不V form: 你想不想去看电影？
Going somewhere to do something: 去打球

lessons.theme: Visiting a friend's home: being invited in, introducing family members, complimenting the house, being offered and choosing drinks, and recounting an evening spent chatting at someone's place.

vocab.english: (interjectory particle used to soften a question)
(measure word for bottled liquid, etc.); bottle
(measure word for cup or glass); cup; glass
(a dynamic particle indicating a completed action)
to chat about; to talk over (takes a topic)

grammar.description: 一下 and (一)点儿 after a verb soften the tone of a request or suggestion (我介绍一下 / 喝点儿茶).
Adjectives function directly as predicates without 是; they are usually preceded by 很 and negated with 不 (你家很漂亮).
The preposition 在 introduces the location, which must come before the verb (我在学校工作).
The sentence-final particle 吧 softens a suggestion or request, or expresses a supposition (我喝茶吧 / 你是李友吧?).
The particle 了 after a verb indicates that the action has been completed (他们认识了高文中的姐姐 / 王朋喝了两杯茶).
The adverb 才 indicates that something happens later or more slowly than expected (十二点才回家).
A measure word such as 杯 or 瓶 must stand between a number and a noun (一杯水, 一瓶可乐).
Softens a verb: 介绍一下, 等一下
Adjectives take 很, not 是: 她很漂亮 (not 是漂亮)
Location: 他在图书馆; also before verbs for where actions happen
Later than expected: 他晚上十二点才回家

lessons.theme: Making appointments by phone: calling a teacher or a friend, talking about classes, meetings and exams, finding a time when both people are free, asking for help practicing Chinese, and agreeing when and where to meet.

vocab.english: to open; to hold (a meeting, party, etc.)
to give or take a test; test
after; from now on; later on
don't be so polite; you're welcome
(a sentence-final particle of exclamation, interrogation, etc.)
to meet up; to meet with
to go online; to surf the internet

grammar.pattern: S + 给 + 某人 + 打电话
grammar.description: The preposition 给 introduces the person an action is directed to, and comes before the verb (我给老师打电话). For example: S + gěi + mǒu rén + dǎ diànhuà.
The auxiliary verb 要 expresses an intention or a scheduled/future action (今天下午我要开会).
别 before a verb forms a negative command telling someone not to do something (别客气 / 别等我).
要是 introduces a condition, often answered by 就 in the main clause (要是您方便，我就四点半来).
到 plus a place plus 来 or 去 expresses coming or going to that place (我到您的办公室去).
来 and 去 attached to a verb show direction relative to the speaker (进来, 回来, 回去).
Time-when expressions precede the verb and run from the largest unit to the smallest (明天下午四点半见).
The auxiliary verb 得 expresses necessity or obligation; its negative is 不用, not 不得 (我得准备考试).
Pivotal sentence: the object of the first verb is also the subject of the second verb (我想请你帮我练习中文).
给 marks the recipient: 我给妈妈打电话 For example: gěi sb. dǎ diàn huà.
If... then...; 就 in the second clause For example: yào shi…(de huà)，jiù….
'Must / have to'; negation is 不用, never 不得
'After X': 考试以后 — clause + 以后, not 以后 + clause

lessons.theme: Talking about how a Chinese class went: previewing and reviewing, writing characters, grammar and new vocabulary, and describing how well or badly you did something.

vocab.english: where; (a modest reply to a compliment)
to learn; to study (the single character)
to go to class; to attend class
to study; studies (also used as a noun)

grammar.description: Describes how well an action is performed: 他说中文说得很好 — he speaks Chinese very well. The verb repeats before 得 when there is an object.
Excessively; too: 太难了 (too hard). Marks a degree past what is comfortable.
Emphasises that something happened sooner or more readily than expected: 七点就来了 (came as early as seven).
As soon as A, then B: 我一上课就懂了 (as soon as class started I understood).
Fronting the object for emphasis or contrast: 汉字我写得很慢 (as for characters, I write them slowly).

grammar.pattern: Question word 怎么 vs 为什么
grammar.description: 怎么 asks how (manner) and can carry surprise; 为什么 asks the reason directly.
Descriptive complements: 他写字写得很好 / 你说得太快了
Asking how to do something: 这个字怎么写？
教你中文, 给我一枝笔 — person before thing
Exclamatory 'really': 你的中文真好！
'A bit (undesirably)': 语法有一点儿难

lessons.theme: A diary entry and a letter about a typical day at school: getting up, meals, class, the computer lab and the library, plus talking about your major and what you can do.

vocab.english: to take a bath or shower
to let; to allow; to make

grammar.description: 新的、我的、说中文的人 — 的 turns a modifier into a noun phrase, and the noun can be dropped when it is obvious.
An action in progress right now: 他正在上网呢 (he's online at the moment).
In addition to X, also Y: 除了中文以外，我还学日文.

grammar.pattern: 能 vs 会 vs 可以
grammar.description: 会 = learned skill, 能 = physical possibility or capacity, 可以 = permission.
When…: 我吃饭的时候看电视 (I watch TV while eating).
Placed after the clause it modifies: 上课以前 (before class), 下课以后 (after class).
Two simultaneous actions: 一边吃饭一边看电视 For example: yī biān…yī biān….
Action in progress: 我正在写日记
'Besides X, also Y'; with 都 it means 'except' For example: chú le…yǐ wài，huán….
会 = learned skill; 能 = circumstances/permission
'Before X': 上课以前 — clause + 以前
in addition to; besides

lessons.theme: Buying clothes and shoes: colors, sizes, measure words, prices in 块/毛/分, trying things on, exchanging an item, and paying by card.

vocab.english: (measure word for the basic Chinese monetary unit)
(measure word for 1/10 of a kuai; dime)
(measure word for 1/100 of a kuai; cent)
to pay with a credit card
to pay money; to hand over cash

grammar.pattern: 的 to omit a repeated noun
grammar.description: 黄的、大的 — once the noun is established, 的 alone carries it: 我要黄的 (I want the yellow one).
grammar.pinyin: de to omit a repeated noun

grammar.description: 多大? 多长? — asks the degree of a quality rather than a quantity.

grammar.pattern: Amount of money: 块 / 毛 / 分
grammar.description: 三十五块八毛五分. In speech the last unit is often dropped: 三十五块八毛五.
grammar.pinyin: Amount of money: kuài / máo / fēn

grammar.description: Although X, still Y. Both halves are stated in Chinese, unlike English.
A is (not) the same as B: 这件跟那件一样.
If…: often paired with 如果 — 如果太贵的话，我就不买了.
块/毛/分 in order, last unit droppable: 十八块五
'The same as': 这件跟那件一样 (+adj: 一样大)
件 for tops, 条 for pants/skirts, 双 for pairs
多大 / 多长 / 多贵 to ask degree

lessons.theme: Getting around and getting home for the winter break: buses, subway, taxi, driving, giving a sequence of directions, and an email thanking someone.

vocab.english: to go by way of; to walk
to see off; to take (someone somewhere)

grammar.description: 或者 offers alternatives in a statement; 还是 offers them in a question.
Sequences steps: first…, then…, after that…. Standard for giving directions. For example: xiān…, zài…, ránhòu….
Every one of them: 每天都有课 (I have class every day). 都 is required.
You'd better…: 你还是坐地铁吧 (you'd better take the subway).

grammar.pattern: Verbs of means: 坐 / 开 / 走
grammar.description: 坐飞机 (travel by plane), 开车 (drive), 走路 (go on foot) — the means precedes the main verb.
grammar.pinyin: Verbs of means: zuò / kāi / zǒu

grammar.description: From A to B, in space or time: 从学校到机场 (from school to the airport).
Sequencing actions: 先坐地铁，然后换公共汽车
Asking for route vs means of travel For example: zěn me zǒu / zěn me qù.
To let/make someone do something: 妈妈不让我开车

lessons.theme: Talking about the weather and the forecast, comparing two places, and changing plans because of rain or snow.

vocab.english: in a terrible mess; too bad
again (of something that has already happened)

grammar.description: Comparison: 今天比昨天冷 (today is colder than yesterday). 很 never appears in a 比 sentence; use 更 or 还.

grammar.pattern: A 没有 B (这么/那么) + Adj
grammar.description: The negative comparison: 今天没有昨天那么冷.
Both…and…, of two simultaneous qualities: 又冷又下雨.
Not only... but also; subject placement matters For example: bù dàn…ér qiě….
About to happen: 要下雨了 (it's going to rain). Also 快要…了 / 就要…了.
…的时候 spans the action; …以后 places the second event after it finishes.
Comparison: 今天比昨天冷; degree after adj (冷一点儿/冷多了); never 很 before adj
Likelihood: 明天会下雨
刚 (adverb, just did) vs 刚才 (time noun, a moment ago)

lessons.theme: Ordering in a restaurant and eating in a cafeteria: dishes, flavors, dietary needs, telling the waiter you're in a hurry, and complaining that something has sold out.

vocab.english: seat; a place at a table
(measure word for plates or dishes of food)
(of food) cold and dressed with sauce

grammar.description: Extremely: 好吃极了. Follows the adjective, no 很.

grammar.pattern: V + 完 / 到 / 见 / 好
grammar.description: Resultative complements. Attach the result to the verb: 吃完 (finished eating), 看见 (saw), 听到 (heard), 卖完 (sold out).
Puts the object before the verb to say what was done to it: 请把菜端上来.
If…, marks the condition at the end of the clause.
再 for repetition that hasn't happened yet; 又 for repetition that already has.
Do more or less of something: 多放点儿盐, 少放味精.
Completion: 卖完了, 吃完了; negation 没卖完
Emphatic negation: 一点儿盐都别放
Extreme degree: 好吃极了
'Just did': 白菜刚卖完

lessons.theme: Finding your way on and off campus: left and right, front and back, traffic lights and intersections, and describing where one building is relative to another.

vocab.english: to hear of; it is said that

grammar.description: Distance between two points: 学校离我家很近.

grammar.pattern: 从 A 到 B 怎么走？
grammar.description: The standard way to ask for directions.
grammar.pinyin: cóng A dào B zěnme zǒu？

grammar.description: 往前走 (go straight ahead), 往右拐 (turn right).
Position words with 的. 图书馆的旁边 — the position word follows the reference point.

grammar.pattern: 没有 vs 不 with 有
grammar.description: 有 is negated only by 没, never by 不.
Not even one: 我一次也没去过.
Distance between places: 学校离我家很近
Directional movement: 往右拐, 往前走
Going to a place: 到运动场去
旁边/前面/后面/里边/中间 attach after nouns: 图书馆旁边
'As soon as': 一过路口就到了

lessons.theme: Planning and attending a birthday party: buying a present, describing people and pets, the Chinese zodiac, and toasting.

vocab.english: (marker moving the object before the verb)
to be born in the year of (the zodiac)

grammar.description: Says what happened to a specific object: 把蛋糕吃完了. Requires a result, direction or 了 after the verb.
Questions take 还是; statements and plans take 或者.
长得很可爱 — how someone looks is expressed with 长得.
Marks an action starting up: 笑起来 (burst out laughing), or judgement: 看起来 (it looks like).
Originally X, later Y — a change of plan.
Emphasises immediacy within a time frame.
Disposal construction: 把礼物给他, 把书带来
Ongoing state: 拿着花, 穿着新衣服
'In addition': 还买了一个蛋糕
Describing appearance: 她长得很像妈妈
以为 marks a mistaken belief; 觉得 a current opinion For example: yǐ wéi vs jué de.

lessons.theme: At the doctor's and the pharmacy: describing symptoms, allergies, taking medicine and how often, and being told to see a doctor sooner.

vocab.english: to get sick from bad food
(measure word for complete courses of an action)

grammar.description: More and more: 越来越冷 (colder and colder). For example: yuè lái yuè + Adj.
An exaggerated degree complement: 疼死了 (it hurts like hell), 饿死了.

grammar.pattern: Duration + V (how long you do something)
grammar.description: 我看了三个小时 — the length of time follows the verb.
No matter how X: 再忙也要吃饭.
Hurry and do X, otherwise Y — urging with a consequence.

grammar.pattern: Measure words 次 vs 遍
grammar.description: 次 counts occurrences; 遍 counts complete run-throughs from start to finish.
Extreme degree: 疼死了, 饿死了
Progressive change: 天气越来越热 For example: yuè lái yuè + adj.
'Otherwise': 赶快吃药，要不然病会越来越重 For example: yào bù rán.
Allergic to: 我对味精过敏
Both count occurrences; 遍 means start-to-finish through

lessons.theme: Asking someone out and turning someone down: going to a film or a show, being busy, getting to know someone, and the awkwardness of a first date.

vocab.english: to remember; to call to mind

grammar.pattern: V + 出来 / 起来 / 下去
grammar.description: Direction added to a verb, often figuratively: 想起来 (recall), 说出来 (say it out), 住下去 (keep on living there).
就 = sooner or more easily than expected; 才 = later or with more difficulty than expected.
If X then Y — the colloquial partner of 如果.
Reduplicated verbs. Softens a request and suggests doing something briefly or casually.
Can or cannot achieve a result: 看得懂 / 看不懂, 买得到 / 买不到.
To have (no) impression of someone: 我对他印象很好.
想起来 = to recall; also inchoative 'start to'
Resultative 'into/as': 看成, 翻译成中文
Having a good impression of someone
Taking a lot of (time/effort/money): 费时间, 费力气
That very one / right away: 我就知道

lessons.theme: Moving off campus: reading an ad, rooms and furniture, rent and utilities, quiet neighborhoods, pets and deposits.

vocab.english: even (in the pattern: even X does Y)
(formal measure word for the basic monetary unit)

grammar.description: Even X: 连饭都不会做 (can't even cook).
If that's the case, then…. Common in negotiating and deciding. For example: …de huà, jiù….
Existential 有 / 是 / 着. 桌子上有一本书 — describes what exists at a location.
Highlights when, where or how a past event happened: 我是去年搬来的.
Except for X, all the rest… — the exclusive sense, opposite of the additive one.
Compared with…: 跟宿舍比起来，公寓安静多了.
走路五分钟的地方 — duration modifying nouns
'Roughly': 房租差不多一千块 For example: chà bu duō.
Counting rooms: 两房一厅, 一室一厅 For example: yī fáng yī tīng patterns.
他在这儿住了两年了 — still living there

lessons.theme: Getting exercise and watching sport: gaining weight, jogging and swimming, basketball and football, and arguing about which game is better.

vocab.english: to fear; to be afraid of
to hold or carry in the arms
half a day; a long time

grammar.description: Keep on doing: 这样下去 (if things go on like this), 说下去 (go on talking).
In order to: 为了提高中文水平，我每天听录音.
Passive: 他被压在下面 (he got pinned underneath). Often carries an unwelcome outcome.
Extreme degree complements, both very colloquial.
好看 (good to look at), 难吃 (bad-tasting) — 好/难 plus a verb makes an adjective.

grammar.pattern: 又…又… vs 一边…一边…
grammar.description: 又…又… lists two qualities; 一边…一边… describes two actions at once.
被 + agent + V + complement: 球被他踢走了; often unpleasant
V + duration: 跑了半个小时(的)步; splittable verbs split
'The more... the more...': 越跑越快
Starting a change: 胖起来, 打起球来
Purpose and worry: 怕淹死 — fear clause as reason

lessons.theme: Planning a trip: summer plans, travel agents, one-way and round-trip tickets, airlines and transfers, hotels and rental cars.

vocab.english: famous scenic spots and historic sites
round trip; to go back and forth

grammar.description: If that's the case, you'd best…: 要是想省钱的话，最好早点订票. For example: …de huà, zuìhǎo….
Not X but Y — corrects an assumption.
Either…or… in a statement, listing genuine alternatives.
Unless X, otherwise Y.
Numbers over a hundred. 千/百/十 stack from the largest unit down; 零 fills an internal gap.
Three-step sequencing, useful for itineraries. For example: xiān…, zài…, zuìhòu….
Intentions: 我打算去北京实习
千/万 structure: 一千五(百), 两万
比……贵/便宜 + amount: 贵三百多块
'Some... others...': 有的去打工，有的去旅行 For example: yǒu de…yǒu de….
Sequenced future: 放了假就回家

lessons.theme: Saying goodbye at the airport: checking in and boarding, luggage and customs, promises to write and call, and a first meal back home.

vocab.english: to look after; to take care of
to handle; to take care of
there isn't enough time (to do something)
to go out; to leave home

grammar.description: Reminders and farewells: 上飞机的时候别忘了带护照.
There is (not) enough time to do something — a potential complement. For example: lái de jí / lái bu jí.
A result that holds firm: 记住 (memorise), 站住 (stop where you are).
As soon as A, B: 一下飞机就给我打电话.
All three introduce the doer in a passive sentence; 让 and 叫 are more colloquial.
Both intensify: 累坏了 (worn out), 好极了 (fantastic). For example: …jí le / …huài le.
'When...': 起飞的时候别忘了关手机
Imminent action: 飞机就要起飞了 For example: jiù yào…le / kuài yào…le.
Adverbial 地: 高兴地说, 慢慢地走
Extreme result: 累坏了, 饿坏了
Compound directions: 拿出来, 走进去, 带回家去

lessons.theme: The first weeks back: registering, choosing courses and credits, required and elective classes, professors and TAs, exams and grades, and the pressure of a heavy schedule.

vocab.english: to check in; to register one's arrival
to adapt; to get used to
to take part in; to attend
while you're at it; in passing

grammar.description: Both…and…, in a more formal register than 又…又…: 这门课既有意思又实用.
Not only not X, but on the contrary Y — a reversal of expectation.
As far as X is concerned: 对留学生来说，选课不容易.
看起来 / 听起来 / 说起来 — introduces an impression: 看起来很难.
The more X, the more Y: 越学越有意思.
One of the…: 这是最难的课之一.

lessons.theme: Living with roommates: room types and facilities, tidiness and noise, dorm rules and curfews, working out disagreements, and the cost of living independently.

vocab.english: to endure; to put up with

grammar.pattern: 把 + O + V + 得/成/在/到
grammar.description: The 把 construction with a wider range of results: 把房间打扫干净, 把中文说成日文.
Passive with the doer named: 我被室友吵醒了.
Playing down a solution: 跟他商量一下就好了.
Even if X, still Y — concessive.
Either X or Y, with a note of exasperation: 他不是睡觉就是打游戏.
Doing something back and forth without result: 想来想去 (thinking it over and over).

lessons.theme: Regional cuisines and personal taste: ordering from a menu, cooking methods, describing flavor and freshness, paying the bill, treating versus splitting, and not wasting food.

grammar.description: To take X as Y: 南方人以米饭为主食.
Rather than X, better to Y: 与其在外面吃，不如自己做.
Back and forth with no conclusion: 挑来挑去还是点了老三样.
No matter…, still…: 不管多贵他都要吃.
Couldn't be more…: 这家店再地道不过了.
To be used to doing: 吃惯了辣的 (used to eating spicy food).

lessons.theme: Malls, brands and online shopping: quality and price, bargaining, discounts and promotions, returns and receipts, mobile payment and delivery, and whether something is worth it.

vocab.english: to make a payment; to settle up

grammar.pattern: A 比 B + Adj + 一点/得多/多了
grammar.description: 比 with a difference. Quantifies the gap: 这件比那件贵得多 / 便宜一点儿.
grammar.pinyin: A bǐ B + Adj + yìdiǎn / de duō / duō le

grammar.description: 我是在网上买的 — highlights where or how, when the event itself is known.
As long as X, then Y — a sufficient condition.
Only if X will Y happen — a necessary condition.
倒是 concedes a point mildly: 贵倒是贵，可是质量好. For example: …de huà, dàoshì….

grammar.pattern: V + 得起 / V + 不起
grammar.description: Can or cannot afford: 买得起 / 买不起.

lessons.theme: Deciding what to study: subjects and their names, interest versus job prospects, parental expectations, salary and stability, and sticking with a choice or giving it up.

vocab.english: to persist in; to insist on

grammar.description: To be interested in: 我对历史很感兴趣.
Not X but rather Y — used to correct a misunderstanding.
Since (that's how it is), then…: 既然你喜欢，就选这个专业吧.
Regardless of…: 无论父母怎么说，我都要学音乐.
In the area of…: 他在数学方面很有天分.
States a reason formally: 我换专业的原因是压力太大.

lessons.theme: Relationships: how a couple met, personality and looks, dating and breaking up, jealousy and trust, introducing someone to the family, and what makes a good match.

vocab.english: to date; to be in a relationship
to be unable to get along

grammar.description: 他被她甩了 — the passive commonly marks something unwelcome happening to the subject.

grammar.pattern: V + 得来 / V + 不来
grammar.description: Compatibility as a potential complement: 合得来 / 谈得来.
If it hadn't been for X, Y would have happened — counterfactual.
On one hand… on the other hand… — balances two considerations. For example: yì fāngmiàn…, lìng yì fāngmiàn….
Whether X or Y, it doesn't matter: 高也好矮也好，我都不在乎. For example: …yě hǎo, …yě hǎo.
To treat someone well: 他对我很好.

lessons.theme: Life online: hardware and software, downloading and installing, email and social media, search engines and shopping sites, viruses and passwords, and how much time gets lost to a screen.

vocab.english: to be addicted to; to indulge in

grammar.description: By means of / through: 通过网络认识了很多朋友.
Along with (a change): 随着技术的发展，生活越来越方便.
The written-register partner of 不但…而且….
To treat X as Y: 别把网络当成真实的世界.
By a large margin: 新电脑快多了.
Result complements: 连上网 (get connected), 存下来 (save it down).

lessons.theme: Finding and holding a part-time job: applications and résumés, hourly pay and hours, tips and taxes, balancing work with study, and what a first job teaches.

grammar.description: Doing two things at once: 一边打工一边念书.
In order to X, one has no choice but Y.
Both…and… linking two verbs or clauses.
Either one or the other, describing a repetitive routine.
Including both: 连工资带小费一共八百块.

grammar.pattern: V + 下来 / V + 下去
grammar.description: 存下来 (save up), 做下去 (keep doing it) — result versus continuation.

lessons.theme: Comparing school systems: exams and the college entrance examination, memorisation versus discussion, class size and homework, tutoring and cram schools, and what parents expect.

vocab.english: to pass the exam and get in
to hope one's child will become successful

grammar.description: Compared with… — the written-register form of 跟…比.
The reason X is that Y — puts the result first. For example: zhī suǒyǐ…, shì yīnwèi….
No matter whether X or Y.
由 marks who is responsible for something: 成绩由考试决定.
Correlated increase: 竞争越来越厉害.
Under the influence of…: 在父母的影响下，他选了医学.

lessons.theme: The shape of the country: provinces and major cities, rivers and mountains, north and south, population and climate, minority regions, and travelling from the coast to the interior.

grammar.description: Formal location: 上海位于长江的入海口.
To account for: 汉族占人口的百分之九十以上.
To be made up of: 中国由三十多个省市自治区组成.
Famous for: 桂林以山水著名.
Approximation and thresholds after a number.
Judging from…: 从面积来看，中国是世界第三大国.

lessons.theme: The festival calendar: Spring Festival, the Lantern, Dragon Boat and Mid-Autumn festivals, the lunar calendar, reunions and red envelopes, customs and their legends.

vocab.english: to pay a New Year call
to gather for the New Year

grammar.description: Whenever (a festival or occasion) comes round: 每逢春节都要回家.
Explains the purpose behind a custom.
It is said that… — introduces a legend or hearsay.
Not only X, even Y — stacking emphasis.
V + 来 (purpose). 用月饼来象征团圆 — 来 links a means to a purpose.
As something develops: 随着时代的变化，有些风俗慢慢消失了.

lessons.theme: Three decades of change: reform and opening up, cities and skyscrapers, migrant workers, rising living standards, the gap between rich and poor, and what has been lost along the way.

grammar.description: Ever since…: 自从改革开放以来，中国变化很大.
Comparisons of degree across time: 现在比以前富裕多了.
Weighs benefits against costs — the backbone of a discussion essay. For example: yì fāngmiàn…, lìng yì fāngmiàn….
Formal 'not only… but also…', common in written argument.
To cause something to happen: 改革使人民的生活得到了改善.
At the same time — introduces a countervailing point. For example: yǔ cǐ tóngshí.

lessons.theme: Travelling in China: package tours versus going it alone, booking and itineraries, scenic spots and crowds, souvenirs and haggling, and the etiquette of being a good guest.

vocab.english: to explain; to give a commentary
when in Rome, do as the Romans do

grammar.description: Rather than X, it's better to Y: 与其跟团，不如自己去.
It's only…: 门票也不过五十块.
Any and every X: 凡是来北京的游客都会去长城.
To take advantage of a time or condition: 趁着淡季去，人少票便宜.
走遍了中国 (travelled all over China) versus 去过 (have been to).
Either one or the other, here listing what fills a trip.

lessons.theme: Living well: diet and exercise, sleep and stress, smoking and drinking, Chinese and Western medicine, staying in shape, and the habits worth changing.

vocab.english: fat (the substance in food or the body)
to quit; to give up (a habit)

grammar.description: To be bad or good for: 抽烟对身体有害.
If you want X, you have to Y.
Would rather X than Y: 我宁可少睡也要锻炼.
越熬夜越没精神 — links two escalating tendencies.
So as to avoid: 早点睡，以免第二天没精神.
According to… — the standard way to cite a source in writing.

lessons.theme: Roles at home and at work: housework and childcare, equal pay and promotion, traditional attitudes, women in leadership, and how expectations differ between generations.

grammar.description: In someone's view: 在我看来，家务应该分担.
Not necessarily: 男人不见得比女人更适合当领导.
Should be X rather than Y — the shape of an argument sentence.
Concede, then hold your ground — standard for a discussion essay.
More and more people…: opens a paragraph about social change. For example: yuè lái yuè duō de rén….
A nominalising frame for contrast: 让人担心的是，偏见还没有消失.

lessons.theme: The trade-off between growth and the environment: air and water pollution, energy and recycling, factories and regulations, climate change, and what an individual can actually do.

vocab.english: to bring under control; to govern

grammar.description: At the cost of…: 不能以环境为代价发展经济.
Not only not X, but the opposite Y — the shape of a warning.
Only if X will Y — the strongest conditional in the set.
To lead to / to cause — both take an unwelcome result: 污染造成了很多疾病.
To take measures — a fixed collocation in formal writing.
While doing X, also Y — balances two obligations.

lessons.theme: Handling money: budgeting and saving, banks and interest, stocks and funds, risk and return, credit cards and debt, insurance, and planning for the long term.

vocab.english: to provide for one's old age

grammar.description: Predicting a consequence: 不小心的话，就会亏很多钱. For example: …de huà, jiù huì….
Rather than X, better Y — with 倒 adding a note of preference.
Up until…: 到目前为止，股市还没有恢复.
Because X, therefore Y — the formal cause-and-effect pair.
Percentages: 百分之五的利息. 增长了 versus 增长到 differ in meaning. For example: bǎi fēn zhī….
Whatever happens, you must…: 不管市场怎么变，都要有长期计划.

lessons.theme: Where tradition still shows: Confucian ideas of family and respect, calligraphy, tea and opera, face and relationships, and how young people relate to all of it today.

vocab.english: elder; senior member of a family
to value; to think highly of

grammar.description: To be influenced by: 中国人受儒家思想的影响很深.
So-called X means Y — used to define a term.
Whether X or Y — a literary version of …也好，…也好.
In respect of: 在饮食上, 在教育上 — frames a domain.
As far as X goes — formal topic marker in essays.
Stacking three qualities in formal description. For example: jì…, yòu…, hái….

lessons.theme: Looking for work after graduation: reading job ads, writing a résumé and cover letter, preparing for and getting through an interview, and talking about salary, benefits and expectations.

vocab.english: to be promoted; to advance in rank
to suit; to be suitable for

grammar.description: The reason I applied is that… — puts the claim before the reason. For example: zhī suǒyǐ…, shì yīnwèi….
Not merely X, but even more Y — raising the stakes politely. For example: bùjǐnjǐn shì…, gèng shì….

grammar.pattern: 如果有机会的话，我希望…
grammar.description: A polite hypothetical frame for stating what you want.
To be confident about: 我对这份工作很有信心.
Once did X — formal past experience, common on a résumé.
The formal counterpart of 能, preferred in interviews and writing.

lessons.theme: Looking ahead: further study or work, staying abroad or going home, career and family plans, saying goodbye to friends, and reflecting on what studying Chinese has changed.

vocab.english: to say goodbye; to bid farewell
to be reluctant to part with

grammar.description: No matter what, still… — a closing commitment. For example: wúlùn rúhé, dōu….

grammar.pattern: 不是…就是… / 要么…要么…
grammar.description: Either X or Y, laying out two live options for the future.
这几年学下来 — 下来 wraps up a period and its result.
Has made me…: 学中文使我的眼界开阔了很多.
Looking back on it — opens a reflective paragraph.
If only; I do hope… — a warmer, more literary 希望.
